strings.events.mtaDelay.title: Train delay
strings.events.mtaDelay.body: Your train is running late, with no word on when it will show up.
strings.events.mtaDelay.wait.label: Wait for the train
strings.events.mtaDelay.walk.label: Walk instead
strings.events.mtaDelay.walk.result: You walked. Your legs are tired, but you feel good.
strings.events.mtaDelay.slice.label: Grab a slice while you wait
strings.events.mtaDelay.slice.result: You ate a slice while you waited.
strings.events.rentHike.title: Rent increase
strings.events.rentHike.body: Your landlord left a note: there is a new monthly building fee.
strings.events.rentHike.pay.label: Pay the fee
strings.events.rentHike.haggle.label: Argue it down
strings.events.rentHike.haggle.result: You argued it down to a smaller fee.
strings.events.rentHike.ignore.label: Ignore the note for now
strings.events.rentHike.ignore.result: You ignored the note. It is still bugging you.
strings.events.freePizza.title: Free pizza
strings.events.freePizza.body: A party at the pizza place ordered too much, and they are giving slices away.
strings.events.freePizza.grab.label: Grab a slice
strings.events.freePizza.pass.label: Keep walking
strings.events.clubPromoter.title: Club promoter
strings.events.clubPromoter.body: A promoter outside the club offers you a spot on the guest list, or cash to hand out flyers.
strings.events.clubPromoter.flyers.label: Hand out flyers for cash
strings.events.clubPromoter.flyers.result: You handed out flyers and got paid.
strings.events.clubPromoter.list.label: Get on the list and dance
strings.events.clubPromoter.list.result: You got in and danced for hours. People noticed you.
strings.events.clubPromoter.pass.label: Head home
strings.events.viralMoment.title: You went viral
strings.events.viralMoment.body: Someone filmed you at just the right moment, and the clip is taking off.
strings.events.viralMoment.post.label: Post it
strings.events.viralMoment.post.result: You posted it. Your follower count is climbing.
strings.events.viralMoment.keep.label: Keep it to yourself
strings.events.viralMoment.keep.result: You let it pass. It still made your day.
strings.events.phoneGrab.title: Phone grab
strings.events.phoneGrab.body: Someone on a scooter reached for your phone as they rolled past.
strings.events.phoneGrab.hold.label: Hold on tight
strings.events.phoneGrab.hold.result: You held on. They rolled off with nothing.
strings.events.phoneGrab.yell.label: Shout at them
strings.events.phoneGrab.yell.result: You shouted. They wobbled, nearly fell and scooted away.
strings.events.pickpocket.title: Pickpocket
strings.events.pickpocket.body: On the crowded platform, you feel a hand slip out of your pocket with some of your cash.
strings.events.pickpocket.shrug.label: Let it go
strings.events.pickpocket.chase.label: Chase them
strings.events.pickpocket.chase.result: You chased them down the platform. They dropped your cash and ran.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.title: Golden hour on the bridge
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.body: The sun is setting behind the Brooklyn Bridge, and the light is perfect.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.photo.label: Take a photo
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.photo.result: You took a great photo. People are liking it.
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.view.label: Just enjoy the view
strings.events.bridgeGoldenHour.view.result: You stood and watched the sky change. Peaceful.
strings.events.parkBusker.title: Busker in the park
strings.events.parkBusker.body: A busker with a guitar asks if anyone knows the chorus.
strings.events.parkBusker.sing.label: Sing the chorus
strings.events.parkBusker.sing.result: You sang along, and a small crowd clapped.
strings.events.parkBusker.tip.label: Give a tip
strings.events.parkBusker.tip.result: You gave a tip. The busker nodded thanks.
strings.events.parkBusker.walk.label: Keep walking
strings.events.touristPhoto.title: Photo request
strings.events.touristPhoto.body: A tourist asks you to take a photo of their group.
strings.events.touristPhoto.help.label: Take the photo
strings.events.touristPhoto.help.result: You took a good photo, and they thanked you.
strings.events.touristPhoto.point.label: Point them to someone else
strings.events.touristPhoto.point.result: You pointed them to someone else.
strings.events.bodegaCat.title: Bodega cat
strings.events.bodegaCat.body: The bodega cat jumps onto the counter and stares at you.
strings.events.bodegaCat.scratch.label: Pet the cat
strings.events.bodegaCat.scratch.result: The cat purred. You feel calmer.
strings.events.bodegaCat.treat.label: Buy the cat a treat
strings.events.bodegaCat.treat.result: The cat loved the treat. You made a friend.
strings.events.blockParty.title: Block party
strings.events.blockParty.body: A street is closed for a block party with music and food.
strings.events.blockParty.join.label: Join the party
strings.events.blockParty.join.result: You danced, ate and met your neighbors.
strings.events.blockParty.skip.label: Keep going
strings.events.downpour.title: Sudden rain
strings.events.downpour.body: It starts pouring with no warning.
strings.events.downpour.umbrella.label: Buy an umbrella
strings.events.downpour.umbrella.result: You bought an umbrella and stayed dry.
strings.events.downpour.run.label: Run for it
strings.events.downpour.run.result: You ran for it and got soaked.
strings.events.downpour.wait.label: Wait under an awning
strings.events.downpour.wait.result: You waited until the rain eased off.
strings.events.nameMisspelled.title: Wrong name on the cup
strings.events.nameMisspelled.body: The barista wrote a completely different name on your cup.
strings.events.nameMisspelled.post.label: Post the cup
strings.events.nameMisspelled.laugh.label: Laugh it off
strings.events.lateNightCart.title: Late-night food cart
strings.events.lateNightCart.body: A food cart on the corner is still serving.
strings.events.lateNightCart.plate.label: Get a plate
strings.events.lateNightCart.plate.result: You ate a hot plate of food. Much better.
strings.events.lateNightCart.skip.label: Keep walking
